kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-create-queue --enterprise-id 7000002 --queue ServiceLevel=10 AnnounceSound=0 WrapupTime=30 MaxLen=0 Description=queueName AnnouncePosition=0 AnnounceSoundFile=announceSoundFile3 CreateTime=2026-04-20_10:00:00 QueueTimeout=80 AnnounceSoundFrequency=10 AnnouncePositionYouarenext=0 AnnouncePositionParam=2 MemberTimeout=25 Weight=8 JoinEmpty=1 Qno=3003 MusicClass=default Strategy=rrordered Retry=5 SayAgentno=true VipSupport=1 AnnouncePositionFrequency=0 --queue-skills SkillLevel=10 SkillId=66 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudCreateQueue

parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Call Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

fields.help_en:
The position announcement mode. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Plays when the position is greater than the announce_position_param value.
2: Plays when the position is less than or equal to the announce_position_param value
fields.help_zh: 位置播报 0关闭 1大于announce_position_param时播放 2小于等于announce_position_param时播放
fields.name: announce_position

fields.help_en: The interval for position announcements. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 位置播报周期，秒数
fields.name: announce_position_frequency

fields.help_en: The threshold for position announcements. The announcement is played when the number of callers is greater than or less than this value. The value must be greater than or equal to 2
fields.help_zh: 多余少余n个时播报，必须大于等于2
fields.name: announce_position_param

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to announce "You are next". Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
fields.help_zh: 是否播报'您是下一位',0关闭，1开启
fields.name: announce_position_youarenext

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to play a fixed voice announcement. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
fields.help_zh: 播报固定语音 0关闭 1打开
fields.name: announce_sound

fields.help_en: The fixed voice file
fields.help_zh: 固定语音文件
fields.name: announce_sound_file

fields.help_en: The interval for playing the fixed voice announcement. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 播放固定语音周期，秒数
fields.name: announce_sound_frequency

fields.help_en: The creation time. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
fields.help_zh: 创建时间，格式: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
fields.name: create_time

fields.help_en: The queue name
fields.help_zh: 队列名
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether callers can join the queue when it is empty. Valid values:

1: busy
2: in call
4: ringing
8: invalid
16: wrap-up
fields.help_zh: 队列中为空时是否可以join，取值：1：置忙 2：通话中 4：振铃 8：无效 16：整理
fields.name: join_empty

fields.help_en: The maximum number of callers waiting in the queue. Valid values: 0 to 999. A value of 0 indicates no limit
fields.help_zh: 最大等待数，设置范围0-999，0表示不做任何限制
fields.name: max_len

fields.help_en: The agent timeout period. Valid values: 20 to 60. Unit: seconds. Default value: 25
fields.help_zh: 座席超时时间，取值范围20-60秒，默认25秒
fields.name: member_timeout

fields.help_en: The hold music class
fields.help_zh: 等待语音class
fields.name: music_class

fields.help_en: The queue number
fields.help_zh: 队列号
fields.name: qno

fields.help_en: The queue timeout period. Valid values: 20 to 600. Unit: seconds. Default value: 600
fields.help_zh: 队列超时时间，取值范围20-600秒，默认600秒
fields.name: queue_timeout

fields.help_en: The delay in seconds before calling the next agent when the current agent does not answer within the timeout period
fields.help_zh: 座席超时无应答,呼叫下一座席的延迟秒数
fields.name: retry

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to announce the agent number. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
fields.help_zh: 语音报号，true:播报，false:不播报
fields.name: say_agentno

fields.help_en: The service level threshold in seconds. Calls answered within this time are considered high service level
fields.help_zh: 服务水平秒数，低于此时间内接听的认为是高服务水平
fields.name: service_level

fields.help_en:
The call strategy. Valid values:

rrordered: skill priority
rrmemory: round robin
fewestcalls: fewest calls
random: random
linear: sequential
leastrecent: longest idle time
fields.help_zh: 呼叫策略：rrordered:技能优先 rrmemory:轮选 fewestcalls:平均 random:随机 linear:顺序 leastrecent:最长空闲时间
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether VIP is supported. Valid values:

1: Supported.
0: Not supported
fields.help_zh: 是否支持vip，1:支持，0:不支持
fields.name: vip_support

fields.help_en: The queue priority. Valid values: 1 to 10. A higher value indicates a higher priority
fields.help_zh: 队列优先级，取值范围1-10，数值越高，优先级越高
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en: The wrap-up time. Valid values: 3 to 3600. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 整理时间，取值范围3-3600秒
fields.name: wrapup_time

fields.help_en: The skill ID
fields.help_zh: skill的id
fields.name: skill_id

fields.help_en: The skill level
fields.help_zh: 技能值
fields.name: skill_level
